name: GumbelCDF Density Activation with High Transmittance Initialization
definition: A robust recipe for NeRFs involving parameterizing distance and volume densities in log space and using a closed-form initialization formula to guarantee high ray transmittance, ensuring consistency across different scene scalings.
summary: GumbelCDF Density Activation with High Transmittance Initialization is a NeRF strategy that uses log-space parameterization and a Gumbel CDF offset to ensure consistent scene transparency and prevent local optima.
